verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-defined rule engine that fires actions on events. Webhooks (WORKFLOW_COMPLETED) are developer building blocks for building automation externally. The configurable risk-score equation and screening-list configurations are adjacent settings, not event-triggered actions. The agentic auto-escalation and auto-remediation behaviors are fixed vendor behavior, standardized and not customizable on the Starter Plan, rather than rules the user defines.
